question: Which automobile company successfully conducted a launch and landing test of its first experimental reusable rocket on June 17, 2025, in Hokkaido, Japan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Honda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **June 17, 2025**, the **Honda Motor Co., Ltd.** successfully conducted a landmark launch and landing test of its **first experimental reusable rocket**.
 
• The test was carried out in **Hokkaido**, **Japan**, specifically utilizing the coastal geography which is ideal for aerospace testing and safe recovery operations.
 
• This successful mission marked **Honda's** official entry into the competitive field of **reusable launch vehicles**, joining a select group of global entities capable of vertical landing technology.
 
• The primary objective of the test was to validate the **autonomous guidance and control systems** required for the rocket to return to a **vertical landing pad** after flight.
